title: SurrealDB 2.2.0 before 4.0.0 includes the record id of a referencing row in the error returned when a delete is…
description: SurrealDB versions from 2.2.0 up to but not including 4.0.0 expose record IDs of referencing rows in error messages when a delete operation is blocked by an ON DELETE REJECT reference. This exposure occurs without verifying the caller's SELECT permission on those referencing rows. As a result, an authenticated user with DELETE permission can infer the existence and exact IDs of referencing records that would otherwise be hidden by row-level SELECT restrictions.
